figurative_meaning_en: A person on the verge of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অবস্থা এখন গঙ্গাযাত্রীর মতো হয়ে গেছে।
বয়সের কারণে দাদু গঙ্গাযাত্রী হয়ে পড়েছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: His condition has become like that of a Ganges pilgrim now.
Due to old age, grandfather has become a dying man.
history: This idiom draws from the Hindu tradition where terminally ill individuals undertake a pilgrimage to the Ganges River, believing that dying there grants salvation (moksha).
note: The idiom reflects the cultural reverence for the Ganges in Bengali Hindu society.
